newsitem.title: USA: Jones Medical agrees to buy Abana.
newsitem.headline: Jones Medical agrees to buy Abana.

text.p: Jones Medical Industries Inc said Thursday it has agreed to acquire Abana Pharmaceuticals Inc, a regional marketer of specialty prescription pharmaceuticals.

Under the terms of the transaction, Jones Medical said it will issue about 420,000 shares of its common stock to Abana shareholders to acquire 100 percent ownership. The company said it acquired in 1992 about 16 percent of Abana for $500,000 as an investment.
Abana, based in Birmingham, Ala., has about $5 million in annual sales and 65 employees, including 50 full-time sales representatives. It principally markets respiratory care products.
The transaction is subject to federal securities laws and other regulations. It is expected to be completed by the end of 1996.
Jones Medical is a specialty pharmaceutical manufacturer.
